outputs.scope: Validate inventory loading from the observed backend network request through the Inventory UI, including response success, populated data, product details, displayed count, and loading-time errors.
outputs.approach: Cover UI and API/network behavior in end-to-end scenarios. Identify inventory-related traffic from browser capture; do not assume a service endpoint, response schema, or undocumented error-state behavior. Future automation must use Playwright Test, not the legacy Selenium/Cucumber/TestNG framework.

coverage.ui: Log in and open Inventory; verify products render, product details are populated, and a product count is displayed.
coverage.api_network: Capture the inventory-related request and verify a successful response code and populated product data.
coverage.consistency: Compare the response products and corresponding displayed details/count; report any missing, extra, or mismatched data.
traceability: Products and details match backend data

coverage.ui: During inventory loading, detect client-side errors and verify whether products/details/count are missing or inconsistent; do not assert an unspecified fallback message or recovery behavior.
coverage.api_network: Flag any observed inventory-related unsuccessful response or empty response data as a requirement failure and retain status/response evidence.
traceability: No client-side or server-side errors during inventory loading

coverage.ui: Check the complete displayed product list and count, including the first and last displayed products, against captured response data.
coverage.api_network: Use the captured response's available product records and fields as the comparison source; avoid assuming specific field names or a fixed product count.
coverage.consistency: Verify no response product is omitted or spuriously displayed and that displayed product details match the corresponding response values.
traceability: Products and details match backend data

next_recommendation: Generate manual test cases from this approved plan; no later phase was executed.
